description: This file defines the interface DelinquencyWritePlatformService, which provides methods for managing delinquency ranges, buckets, tags, and related calculations in the loan delinquency management module of the Fineract platform.

classes.name: DelinquencyWritePlatformService
classes.description: Interface for managing delinquency-related operations on loans within the Fineract platform.

methods.name: createDelinquencyRange
methods.description: Creates a new delinquency range based on the provided JSON command.

methods.name: updateDelinquencyRange
methods.description: Updates an existing delinquency range identified by its ID.

methods.name: deleteDelinquencyRange
methods.description: Deletes a delinquency range identified by its ID.

methods.name: createDelinquencyBucket
methods.description: Creates a new delinquency bucket based on the provided JSON command.

methods.name: updateDelinquencyBucket
methods.description: Updates an existing delinquency bucket identified by its ID.

methods.name: deleteDelinquencyBucket
methods.description: Deletes a delinquency bucket identified by its ID.

methods.name: applyDelinquencyTagToLoan
methods.description: Applies a delinquency tag to a loan identified by its ID using the provided command.

methods.name: removeDelinquencyTagToLoan
methods.description: Removes delinquency tags from a loan.

methods.name: cleanLoanDelinquencyTags
methods.description: Removes or resets delinquency tags associated with a loan.

methods.name: calculateDelinquencyData
methods.description: Calculates delinquency data for a loan schedule given current data and a list of delinquency actions.

methods.name: applyDelinquencyTagToLoan
methods.description: Applies delinquency tags to a loan schedule data object based on delinquency actions.

methods.name: createDelinquencyAction
methods.description: Creates a new delinquency action for a loan based on the provided JSON command.
